list_child.name: lsRuns
list_child.desc: Returns the complete list of show runs currently tracked by the company, across every phase from rehearsal through closing. Use this when you need a full sweep of the season's runs rather than a single lookup.

get_child.name: getRun
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single show run record by its unique identifier, including its current phase and scheduling details. This is the single-record counterpart to the full listing call.

list_parent.name: lsProducers
list_parent.desc: Returns every producer the company has worked with, regardless of whether they currently have an active run. Useful for building a full roster rather than a filtered subset.

get_parent.name: getProducer
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single producer's record by id, including the name on file. This does not include any of their associated runs.

delete_child.name: pullRun
delete_child.desc: Permanently strikes a show run from the company's schedule, removing all record of its booking. This action cannot be undone once submitted, so it should be used with care.

set_enum.name: setPhase
set_enum.desc: Advances or reverts a show run's phase among rehearsal, previews, open run, and closed. The company uses this to keep the box office and marketing systems in sync with where a production actually stands.

set_bool.name: setUnderstudy
set_bool.desc: Marks a show run as having a ready understudy, meaning the run can proceed even if a lead is unavailable. Stage management relies on this flag when making last-minute casting calls.

set_ref.name: reassignProducer
set_ref.desc: Transfers a show run from one producer's slate to another's, updating the credited producer of record. This is typically used when a run changes hands mid-season.

send.name: ringProducer
send.desc: Places a call to the producer associated with a given show run, or to a named producer directly. This is the company's standard way of relaying urgent scheduling news.
